system_thesis_interpretation: The repair is scientifically and operationally necessary. Structural capacity is a property of a frozen side set, exact authorized byte-visible history, deterministic policy class, transition system, memory mount, and budget; observed P-ATOMS performance is a separate two-trajectory model outcome. The complete compatibility result supports K_NONE=1/4 and K_P_ATOMS=1/2, so a scientifically valid P-ATOMS 1/2 is legitimate capacity attainment and cannot by itself falsify supplied connected memory. It may pass only the construct-control range, must receive no positive-method credit, and must remain distinct from the stricter descriptive label for 0/2. A 2/2 result is above the certified capacity only if both trajectories truly instantiate one frozen deterministic policy under the same hidden-free interface and runtime; it therefore stops the run for certificate, determinism, leakage, or runtime investigation rather than becoming scientific evidence. Governance replayability is repaired by disclosing the unavailable raw Stage-A bytes and freshly binding current available bytes plus a mechanically recomputable semantic projection; the repair must never assert raw-byte equivalence to the missing report.
graph_delta_interpretation: RML_G1_SELECTED_SLICE_CERTIFIER is a one-way offline evaluator downstream of a sealed pretarget source/store universe and an irrevocably sealed selected manifest. For NONE its registered set is exactly J_H, J_TWIN, P_H, P_TWIN; for P-ATOMS it is exactly P_H, P_TWIN. One total deterministic policy maps each complete canonical authorized controller history to the next legal phase output. History includes the frozen public target and initial observation, slot and phase, every normalized emitted READ key or ENV action, exact authorized return status/row/handle, every prior public result code/text/state, and any other runtime-exposed bytes. Equal history bytes force equal output bytes across sides; branching is allowed only after authorized bytes differ. Hidden side/truth, scores, selection work, candidate rank, certifier state, policies, witnesses, and capacity are excluded. Scratch and citations may be normalized away only under a checked proof that they are self-authored deterministic functions and cannot affect returns, transitions, legality, or structural success. Exactness requires a replayable shared-policy lower-bound table and an independently checked complete upper-bound certificate over all successful traces or an equivalent full-history dynamic program; fixed action-signature intersection is diagnostic only. RML_G1_P_ATOMS_EMPIRICAL_GATE consumes typed frozen trace outcomes, not certificate-side truth: 0/2 is STRICT_CONTROL_CLEAN, 1/2 is CAPACITY_ATTAINING_QUALIFIED_CONTROL, and 2/2 is ABOVE_CERTIFIED_CAPACITY_STOP, with both registered outcomes required to be SCIENTIFIC_VALID and all three labels barred from positive-method credit. RML_G1_STAGE_A_CONTEXT_BINDING must bind the exact current report, the exact stable projection recipe/hash/length, a complete D0 semantic dependency manifest, fresh D0 test evidence, and the separately retained volatile receipt; it explicitly records that SHA-256 346bd091e9d037b1e51c8ed735ba5ecfbee50a42d10988d02ebc28c87532855b is unavailable.
loop_delta_interpretation: The loop remains a fail-closed, prospective, no-retry G1 diagnostic. First hermetically compile and seal GOLD, ATOMS, and TWIN base stores, indexes, aliases, order, vocabulary, query universe, handles, renderer inputs, caches/views, and row-level lineage from the sealed public source and source-derived public schema only. Next execute the unchanged deterministic candidate order and all unchanged non-capacity eligibility predicates, record every predecessor and tie key, choose the first otherwise eligible candidate, and irrevocably seal its four-side manifest before hidden truth enters the capacity evaluator. Capacity may not rerank, advance, reject in favor of, or replace a candidate, and no evaluator edge may flow back to selection or cognition. Recompute and independently check K_NONE=1/4 and K_P_ATOMS=1/2; any different selected identity, policy domain, denominator, or value stops for a new intake rather than triggering reselection. Then require the original six transitive pre-GPU tests plus all five strengthened repair tests, a fresh independent reviewer and distinct author-side advocate bound to exact frozen packet bytes, and the original target-disjoint canary. Only then may the unchanged roster run: GOLD_REC 4, NONE_REC 4, P ATOMS_REC 2, AUTH_REPLAY 2, SHAM_REC 2, CUT_REC 2, and TWIN_REC 2, with exactly 234 precommitted opportunity identities, at most 234 dispatches, immutable typed terminal/cancelled suffix rows, no transfers or retries, and the unchanged runtime and resource ceilings. Infrastructure, resource, dependency, model-invalid control, leak, provenance, ledger, or above-capacity P failure stops without repair; immutable outputs still require the original two-role post-run review before interpretation.
claim_delta_interpretation: The result record must separate structural_capacity_success_count/denominator from observed_scientific_valid_success_count/registered_denominator and from construct_control_label. P-ATOMS 0/2 and 1/2 are exact finite diagnostic outcomes, not statistical estimates: 0/2 may be called strict-control-clean; 1/2 may be called capacity-attaining qualified control and may continue only through the remaining unchanged G1 gates; neither is proof for GOLD, memory superiority, or learning. P-ATOMS 2/2 is not automatically called leakage; it is an uninterpretable contradiction that requires checking certificate completeness, byte-visible policy equality, reset/determinism, source/serve isolation, and runtime integrity before any new claim or rerun. A missing, invalid, model-invalid, infrastructure-failed, resource-failed, dependency-cancelled, or zero-attempt P trajectory cannot be relabeled a scientific nonsuccess and cannot satisfy either allowed control outcome. The context-recovery claim is equally narrow: current D0 semantics were freshly reviewed from exact available code/report/projection bytes, the volatile receipt is separate, and no reconstruction or equivalence of the unavailable report is claimed. Every original single-fixture, nested-exposure, no-learning, no-generalization, no-adaptivity, no-efficiency, no-paper-evidence, and no-successor-authorization firewall remains binding.
visibility_matrix_interpretation: The matrix is a minimum directional contract and must be realized as capability separation plus byte-level noninterference. SEALED_PUBLIC_SOURCE_AND_SCHEMA is the only content authority for base stores; a hash or generic SRC_PUBLIC label is not affirmative provenance. Every row payload, support record, index, alias, order, vocabulary, query universe, handle, renderer/tokenizer input, projection metadata, cache view, and same-key return needs a deterministic lineage path from exact sealed source/schema leaves and must reproduce hermetically while filesystem, environment, globals, caches, hidden fields, selected side, condition, prior results, and evaluator artifacts are mutated or denied. AUTHORIZED_PUBLIC_TARGET_AND_STATE is a separate byte partition: only a mechanically audited function of the frozen public target projection and current legal public observation may vary. Prefix-conditionally, equal authorized histories plus the same emitted key must yield identical model-visible bytes, errors, and timing class except for the exact sealed row authorized by that key. The target selector may use only sealed source-derived structural data and the prospective rule; HIDDEN_TARGET_TRUTH_AND_SIDE and CAPACITY_POLICY_WITNESS_AND_SCORE remain forbidden until after selection commitment, then visible only to the offline evaluator/scorer. The model resolver must not receive target IDs, side/condition labels, opportunity IDs, candidate rank, capacity values, policies, witnesses, unopened rows, scorer state, or volatile receipts through prompts, serving, ordering, cache/KV/process state, error shape, or timing. VOLATILE_STAGE_A_RESOURCE_RECEIPT is audit-only and cannot influence store bytes, selection, capacity, cognition, or G1 scoring.
acceptance_test_interpretation: RML_G1B_T01_COMPLETE_SHARED_HISTORY_CAPACITY: freeze hashes for the pretarget stores, selected manifest, full observation renderer, legal query/return alphabet, 23-action ENV alphabet, four-READ/nine-ENV reducer, D0 transition/terminal authority, and success predicate. Prove READ non-splitting or enumerate every reachable READ history; exhaustively enumerate all single-side successful nine-ENV traces; solve compatibility using exact history bytes, never current-state hashes or open-loop signatures; replay one shared lower-bound policy on every side; and have a separately implemented checker establish that no compatible pair exists for NONE or P-ATOMS. Require exact success vectors K_NONE=1/4 and K_P_ATOMS=1/2. Reject missing/extra histories, actions, traces, tuples, altered feedback, hidden-bit splits, false merges/splits, side-order dependence, fifth READ/tenth ENV, fourth-return or ninth-action errors, noncanonical scratch/citation oracles, and corrupt witnesses/certificates; a synthetic authorized-feedback split must score 2 where open-loop scoring is 1. RML_G1B_T02_CAPACITY_ALIGNED_EMPIRICAL_CONTROL: against a frozen two-row P roster, literal SCIENTIFIC_VALID vectors [0,0], [1,0]/[0,1], and [1,1] must produce respectively STRICT_CONTROL_CLEAN/pass, CAPACITY_ATTAINING_QUALIFIED_CONTROL/pass, and ABOVE_CERTIFIED_CAPACITY_STOP/fail. The 1/2 branch must set strict_control_clean=false and positive_method_credit=false. Every permutation with MODEL_INVALID, INFRASTRUCTURE_FAILURE, RESOURCE_CEILING_EXCEEDED, CANCELLED, missing/duplicate rows, denominator drift, or capacity/manifest mismatch fails; infrastructure/resource failures make the whole run uninterpretable and trigger durable cancellation. Reconstruct the two P model-input histories and verify deterministic same-policy consistency, no side/trajectory identifier, and exact ledger linkage before interpreting 2/2 as above-capacity. RML_G1B_T03_STABLE_STAGE_A_CONTEXT_RECOVERY: start from exact report SHA-256 e36be91f7244dd483a274a1cf350e383011a707d053a02fe753c6f982e9b47c0; parse JSON; delete exactly /gate_values/resource_record and /resource_hash; serialize with one frozen canonical UTF-8 renderer and durable-record LF; and require SHA-256 c496535e08b72d9eb1ff0ba8f6bca4b1f42545a855a6d368e479e99a76a12b0d and 110366 bytes. Preserve and hash the removed receipt separately. Bind and independently recompute a complete transitive D0 semantic code/input manifest, including at least the five hashes declared in governance recovery, rerun all 16 D0 tests, prove two runs differing only in wall/RSS receipts retain the projection, and reject any semantic mutation, third exclusion, missing exclusion, renderer/newline change, code drift, or statement that the unavailable raw report was reproduced. RML_G1B_T04_SOURCE_LINEAGE_AND_LEAK_FIREWALL: run the builder hermetically twice from exact sealed public source/schema leaves and require identical bytes and lineage for every content-bearing or serving artifact. Independently replay/entail every row from its exact source support; generic support labels alone fail. Mutate hidden target fields, pair/side/condition, plans/proofs/scores, capacity policies/results, candidate order, ambient files/environment/globals/cache, and serving prefixes; assert the STORE_BUILD_SERVE_DERIVED partition is invariant and that AUTHORIZED_PUBLIC_TARGET_INTERFACE differences are exactly source-attributed. Given equal public prefix and key, compare complete prompts/returns/errors/order/timing class; prove evaluator outputs have no path to builder, selector after commitment, resolver, service, cache, order, or timing. RML_G1B_T05_EXACT_SCOPE_AND_TRANSITIVE_GATES: machine-diff against original consensus 1c27cbe6ac3adda14078f2cdbfe62785ce7161b4ae35c2fb96b899b40da53cb9, ratification fa6dd830a67ba03dd336945e74759ae58ce075de201573c4037798cba2e4ab53, and the finally ratified v2 bytes. Allow only complete shared-history capacity/certificate machinery, deletion of the false P-zero capacity eligibility and directly dependent text, pre-capacity selection commitment/evaluator isolation, capacity-aligned P 0/1/2 semantics, affirmative source/leak enforcement, and stable-context recovery. Separately allow only behavior-preserving conformance repairs required to satisfy already ratified reducer, citation timing, D0 replay, ledger/machine binding, resource durability, pretarget ordering, runner, and artifact-status gates; they may not alter scientific predicates. Reject every prompt, model/tokenizer/decoding/reset, source content, public target projection, candidate order/tie/non-capacity predicate, selected identity, roster/order/opportunity, resource, reducer/intervention meaning, canary, review role/sequence, claim, retry, or successor-scope drift. Verify all original six replacement tests plus five v2 tests, exact pre-GPU reviews, disjoint canary, immutable 234-row no-retry ledger, and two-role post-run review remain mandatory.
assumptions: The architecture-change SHA-256 was independently recomputed as af878817226180556d03059e0c00a0dc4559df1d579f8b04cc0ca9fca4f5b0a8, and every one of its nine declared context-file hashes was independently recomputed and matched.
This is a prospective repair before any G1 scientific model call; if any target scientific call occurred under the old rule, those outputs cannot be grandfathered into this amended gate.

The exact registered structural side sets are S_NONE={J_H,J_TWIN,P_H,P_TWIN} and S_P_ATOMS={P_H,P_TWIN}, and capacity is an integer maximum achieved by one shared deterministic authorized-visible-history policy, not a probability or per-side oracle maximum.

The stable projection is a fresh identity for current available semantics, not a recovered identity for the unavailable Stage-A bytes; the removed runtime receipt remains separately durable and reviewable.

The sealed public schema/reference is content-free or mechanically derived solely from the same sealed public source and predates candidate selection; it contributes no independent target, answer, plan, relevance, rank, or score facts.

The original ratification authorizes only its already approved G1 scope. This v2 proposal, interpretations, critique, or consensus cannot authorize implementation, a model canary, GPU dispatch, threshold use, or silent context substitution without a new exact human ratification.

Current rml_stage_b code demonstrates feasibility but is not authority: its fixed-signature capacity calculation and old P-ATOMS 0/2 reducer do not satisfy this proposal, and any contemporaneous edits remain outside this interpretation unless later hash-bound and reviewed.

ambiguities.question: Does v2 normatively adopt the v1 consensus selector rule: delete only K_P_ATOMS=0 from eligibility, preserve the complete original candidate order, tie keys, and all other predicates, select the first otherwise eligible candidate, seal it before capacity, and forbid every capacity-conditioned fallback?
ambiguities.impact: The proposal requires selection before capacity but does not itself spell out the repaired eligibility rule. Without exact adoption, hard-coding the known slice or searching until K_P_ATOMS=1 would create selection feedback and invalidate the capacity and control interpretation.

ambiguities.question: Which exact canonical JSON implementation, Unicode normalization rule, UTF-8 escaping rule, and final-LF convention are normative for the declared projection hash and length?
ambiguities.impact: The independently reproduced hash and length require compact sorted-key UTF-8 JSON plus one LF, but the change says only canonical JSON. Equivalent parsed objects can otherwise produce different bytes and break replayability across checkers.

ambiguities.question: Is the five-file D0 hash list in governance_context_recovery.md intended as the complete semantic dependency closure, or only a minimum list to be expanded mechanically to every imported authority, schema, and bound input used to generate and score Stage A and G1?
ambiguities.impact: Binding only five files can miss drift in canonicalization, certificates, schema references, or other imported semantics, so a projection can remain stable while the instrument implementation changes.

ambiguities.question: What exact artifact proves that the two P-ATOMS trajectories instantiate the same deterministic policy, including equal condition-neutral prompts at equal histories, identical model/runtime bytes, reset isolation, and absence of trajectory/opportunity IDs from cognition?
ambiguities.impact: K_P_ATOMS=1/2 bounds one shared policy. If the two runs are allowed different model-visible identifiers, stochastic state, cache state, or hidden routing, a 2/2 observation need not contradict the certified class.

ambiguities.question: Will the final exact allowlist distinguish new architecture semantics from behavior-preserving repairs of the original already ratified citation, D0-replay, opportunity-binding, resource-durability, pretarget-ordering, runner, and artifact-status requirements?
ambiguities.impact: Forbidding every implementation-byte delta would leave the original gates unsatisfied, while treating arbitrary fixes as stricter could covertly redesign the experiment. The audit needs a semantic allowlist plus separately testable conformance repairs.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: Saying that selection occurs before capacity is necessary but not sufficient to preserve selection isolation.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: The original ratified selector contains the now-false K_P_ATOMS=0 eligibility predicate, while v2 does not identify the exact replacement predicate, full candidate order, tie keys, rejected predecessors, selected index, or unexpected-capacity branches. A capacity-blind but newly hard-coded or otherwise changed selector can still cherry-pick the known favorable slice.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Adopt an exact normative selector contract: remove only the false K_P_ATOMS=0 eligibility clause; preserve and materialize the original source-derived candidate universe, order, tie keys, and every other predicate; seal the first otherwise eligible manifest and complete selection trace before hidden truth/capacity; permit no evaluator edge back; and require a new intake rather than fallback on any selected identity, denominator, policy-domain, K_NONE, or K_P_ATOMS drift.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The five manually listed D0 code hashes are not by themselves a complete semantic binding for fresh Stage-A and G1 review.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: The report and G1 scoring also depend on canonicalization, imported modules, schemas, certificate logic, and bound inputs. A changed transitive dependency can alter semantics while all five named hashes and the report projection recipe remain unchanged.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Require T03 to generate and independently verify a closed transitive semantic dependency manifest rooted at the Stage-A generator and every D0 authority consumed by G1, while retaining the five declared hashes as mandatory minimum entries. Any unresolved dynamic import or unbound input fails closed.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: T05's phrase that only four repair categories may differ is too coarse unless it separately types architectural changes and conformance-only repairs to already approved requirements.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: The adversarial audit identifies citation timing, independent D0 replay, opportunity-state binding, durable resource failure, enforced pretarget ordering, runner, and artifact-status gaps. Repairing these is necessary to satisfy original G1 R02-R10 and does not justify changing their scientific meanings, but a literal implementation-byte freeze would prevent closure.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Use a machine-readable two-layer allowlist: the only architecture-semantic deltas are the complete capacity/selection repair, P 0/1/2 interpretation, provenance/evaluator isolation, and stable context recovery; independently enumerated conformance repairs may change code only to meet already ratified predicates and must pass old/new adversarial vectors. Everything else, including prompts, conditions, resources, intervention meanings, retry policy, and claims, fails scope audit.

open_questions: Rohin must ratify exact final bytes that define K_NONE=1/4 and K_P_ATOMS=1/2 over the complete shared authorized-visible-history policy class and change the registered P-ATOMS construct-control semantics to scientifically valid 0/2 strict-control-clean, 1/2 capacity-attaining qualified control, and 2/2 above-capacity stop with no positive-method credit.

The adjudicated bytes must resolve the exact selector repair and stable-projection renderer/dependency closure; neither this interpretation nor the unratified v1 consensus may silently supply missing authority.

Approval must bind the two-layer exact scope allowlist and preserve the original 18 trajectories, 234 registered opportunities, at-most-234 deterministic no-retry dispatches, resources, interventions, six original tests, five repair tests, two-role pre/post review, target-disjoint canary, and claim/successor firewall.

Until that exact ratification and all pre-GPU evidence/reviews exist, implementation of the new threshold/certifier, any model canary, and any GPU/scientific dispatch remain forbidden; a 1/2 result can never be retroactively used to repair an already-run experiment.
